You are auditing ONE CUDA kernel header on a real NVIDIA H100 (sm_90a) build of the SuperGrok1.5 repo (cwd /workspace/SuperGrok1.5). The extension already builds, links, imports, and 10/11 optimizers run; you are hunting LATENT on-device correctness bugs (especially on code paths the grokking race does not exercise, and numeric errors).

Files to read:
 - grokking_optimizers/kernels/sm_90/vit_sm90.cuh   (THE kernel)
 - its canonical optimizer math: (none — model kernel)            (compare the device math against this, if applicable)
 - the binding that calls it: grep csrc/bindings/bindings.cpp for the relevant launch_/op name to see the Python->C++ dtype/shape contract.
 - Optionally the Python optimizer grokking_optimizers/optimizers/vit.py to see what dtypes/shapes it actually passes.


KNOWN BUG CLASSES already confirmed on this H100 (look for MORE of the same):
 (A) Mixed-dtype paired tensors into a single-template kernel: the kernel
     dispatches on ONE tensor's scalar_type() (e.g. weight) then reads a PAIRED
     tensor (e.g. its bias) with data_ptr<SAME_T>(). If Python can pass them in
     different dtypes (weight bf16 via projection_precision='bf16', bias left
     fp32) -> "expected BFloat16 but found Float" at runtime. (Confirmed: SG2
     input_proj_W bf16 vs input_proj_b fp32.)
 (B) Wrong count/loop-bound: a kernel loops 't < n_tasks' or indexes arr[t]
     where n_tasks / the size were set to the ELEMENT count instead of the
     TASK/entry count, walking a small array out of bounds. (Confirmed: fused_step
     n_tasks=n.)
 (C) at:: host ops mixing bf16 weights with fp32 activations without a .to()
     coercion (e.g. a.matmul(b) where a is bf16 and b fp32).
 (D) reshape/view({-1, K}) where the tensor numel may not be divisible by K
     (dimension-wiring mismatch between the passed config int and the actual
     tensor shape). (Confirmed: SG2 meta-net '[-1,44]' vs numel 192.)
 (E) Missing __syncthreads()/__syncwarp() between dependent shared-memory phases,
     or a grid/block index that can exceed the allocated buffer.
 (F) Numeric divergence from the canonical algorithm header (wrong formula,
     swapped operands, missing bias-correction, wrong beta, etc.).


Method: read the kernel fully. For every kernel that dispatches on a tensor dtype, check that ALL tensors it reads with data_ptr<T>() under that branch are guaranteed that dtype. For every reshape/index, check the dimension is derivable and divides. For optimizer kernels, verify the per-element update matches the canonical header formula EXACTLY (operand order, bias-correction, eps placement). 

Report ONLY findings you can back with a specific code snippet and a concrete reachability argument. Prefer precision over recall: a 'certain' high-severity finding is worth far more than ten speculative ones. If the kernel looks correct, return an empty findings array — that is a valid, valuable result. Return the structured object.

231	    __host__ __device__ size_t f_to_act(size_t n_floats) const {
232	        size_t bytes = n_floats * sizeof(float);
233	        size_t a = sizeof(ActT);
234	        return (bytes + a - 1) / a;
235	    }

237	    // Layout (per layer L block):
238	    //   pre_attn_in   [B, S, D]    (the input to attn for layer L; needed for backward)
239	    //   qkv           [B, S, 3*H*Dh]
240	    //   attn_out      [B, S, H*Dh]   (output of attention before output projection)
241	    //   softmax_lse   [B, H, S]      (FP32 reinterpreted)
242	    //   proj_out      [B, S, D]      (= attn output projection result)
243	    //   ln1_in        [B, S, D]      (= pre_attn_in + proj_out, input to LN1)
244	    //   ln1_mean      [B, S] FP32
245	    //   ln1_invstd    [B, S] FP32
246	    //   ln1_out       [B, S, D]      (post-LN1; also serves as ffn input + residual)
247	    //   ffn_h_pre     [B, S, F]      (ff1_W·ln1_out + ff1_b)
248	    //   ffn_h         [B, S, F]      (GELU(ffn_h_pre))
249	    //   ffn_out       [B, S, D]      (ff2_W·ffn_h + ff2_b)
250	    //   ln2_in        [B, S, D]      (= ln1_out + ffn_out, input to LN2)
251	    //   ln2_mean      [B, S] FP32
252	    //   ln2_invstd    [B, S] FP32
253	    //   ln2_out       [B, S, D]      (post-LN2; layer output)
254	    //
255	    // After all layers:
256	    //   final_in      [B, D]         (= ln2_out_last[:, 0, :], the CLS slice)
257	    //   final_mean    [B] FP32
258	    //   final_invstd  [B] FP32
259	    //   final_out     [B, D]
260	    //
261	    // The "tokens" buffer (after patch+CLS+pos) is the layer-0 pre_attn_in.
262	
263	    __host__ __device__ size_t per_layer_count_in_act() const {
264	        size_t s = 0;
265	        s += bsd();              // pre_attn_in
266	        s += bsh();              // qkv
267	        s += bsd();              // attn_out (= H*Dh = D, since H*Dh=d_model in default)
268	                                 // (use H*Dh strictly though; we conservatively allocate bsd
269	                                 //  because H*Dh == d_model in the default config; if this
270	                                 //  invariant is broken at the call-site, attn_out span uses
271	                                 //  H*Dh, not d_model.)
272	        s += f_to_act(bhs());    // softmax_lse (FP32)
273	        s += bsd();              // proj_out
274	        s += bsd();              // ln1_in
275	        s += f_to_act(bs());     // ln1_mean
276	        s += f_to_act(bs());     // ln1_invstd
277	        s += bsd();              // ln1_out
278	        s += bsf();              // ffn_h_pre
279	        s += bsf();              // ffn_h
280	        s += bsd();              // ffn_out
281	        s += bsd();              // ln2_in
282	        s += f_to_act(bs());     // ln2_mean
283	        s += f_to_act(bs());     // ln2_invstd
284	        s += bsd();              // ln2_out
285	        return s;
286	    }

347	// ─── kernels: GEMM (small/general, FP32 accum) ──────────────────────────
348	// out[m, n] = sum_k W[n, k] * in[m, k] + b[n]    (b optional)
349	// Used for patch projection ([B*S, patch_dim] -> [B*S, d_model]),
350	// QKV ([B*S, D] -> [B*S, 3*H*Dh]), out_proj, ff1, ff2, head.
351	//
352	// Block: 1 token at a time per block, each thread handles one or more
353	// output columns. For our small d_model (<= 512) this is bandwidth-bound
354	// and clean to verify correctness.
355	
356	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
357	__global__ void gemm_bias_kernel(
358	    const ActT* __restrict__ in,    // [M, K]
359	    const WeightT* __restrict__ W,  // [N, K]
360	    const WeightT* __restrict__ b,  // [N] or nullptr
361	    ActT* __restrict__ out,         // [M, N]
362	    int M, int N, int K
363	) {
364	    int m = blockIdx.x;
365	    if (m >= M) return;
366	    for (int n = threadIdx.x; n < N; n += blockDim.x) {
367	        float acc = (b != nullptr) ? to_f32(b[n]) : 0.0f;
368	        const WeightT* w_row = W + (size_t)n * K;
369	        const ActT*    a_row = in + (size_t)m * K;
370	        for (int k = 0; k < K; k++) {
371	            acc += to_f32(w_row[k]) * to_f32(a_row[k]);
372	        }
373	        out[(size_t)m * N + n] = from_f32<ActT>(acc);
374	    }
375	}

377	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
378	inline cudaError_t launch_gemm_bias(
379	    const ActT* in, const WeightT* W, const WeightT* b, ActT* out,
380	    int M, int N, int K, cudaStream_t stream
381	) {
382	    int block = 128;
383	    if (N < 128) block = ((N + 31) / 32) * 32;
384	    if (block < 32) block = 32;
385	    gemm_bias_kernel<ActT, WeightT><<<M, block, 0, stream>>>(in, W, b, out, M, N, K);
386	    return cudaGetLastError();
387	}

391	// optionally adding a per-column bias b[N] in the same pass.
392	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
393	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(256, 4)
394	gemm_cast_bias_kernel(const float* __restrict__ src, const WeightT* __restrict__ b,
395	                      ActT* __restrict__ dst, int M, int N) {
396	    size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
397	    if (i >= (size_t)M * N) return;
398	    float v = src[i];

403	// Per-call FP32 scratch for the collective GEMM (lazily grown, reused).
404	inline float* vit_gemm_fp32_scratch(size_t elems) {
405	    static thread_local float* ptr   = nullptr;
406	    static thread_local size_t cap_n = 0;
407	    if (elems > cap_n) {
408	        if (ptr) cudaFree(ptr);
409	        if (cudaMalloc(&ptr, elems * sizeof(float)) != cudaSuccess) {
410	            ptr = nullptr; cap_n = 0; return nullptr;
411	        }
412	        cap_n = elems;
413	    }
414	    return ptr;
415	}

417	// ─── Linear-layer GEMM via the Sm90 collective (TMA + WGMMA) ──────────
418	// Computes  out[M,N] = in[M,K] @ W^T + b   (W is a Linear weight [N,K]
419	// row-major, read as Wᵀ via LayoutBT=ColumnMajor — exactly the convention
420	// of the scalar gemm_bias_kernel it replaces). FP32 accumulate, then a
421	// cast(+bias) pass back into the activation dtype. Reuses the canonical
422	// mma::sm90_run_gemm_bt builder from mma.cuh (modeled byte-for-byte on
423	// fmha_sm90_gemm) — no local CollectiveBuilder. T = half/bf16 (real CUTLASS
424	// element) OR float: for float, cutlass_gemm_elem<float>=tfloat32_t selects the
425	// LIVE TF32 tensor-core mainloop (the float in/W buffers are read as tfloat32_t
426	// — 10-bit mantissa, FP32 accumulate). 🟡 TF32 is NOT bit-identical to scalar
427	// FP32 (23-bit) — accepted FP32 tensor-core precision tradeoff, not a bug.
428	// Returns cudaErrorNotSupported if CUTLASS cannot implement the shape; the
429	// caller falls back to the scalar gemm_bias_kernel.
430	template <typename T>
431	inline cudaError_t vit_linear_gemm_bias(
432	    const T* in, const T* W, const T* b, T* out,
433	    int M, int N, int K, cudaStream_t stream)
434	{
435	    using Elem = typename cutlass_gemm_elem<T>::type;
436	    float* c_fp32 = vit_gemm_fp32_scratch((size_t)M * N);
437	    if (c_fp32 == nullptr) return cudaErrorMemoryAllocation;
438	    cudaError_t err = mma::sm90_run_gemm_bt<Elem, cutlass::layout::ColumnMajor>(
439	        M, N, K, in, W, c_fp32, stream);
440	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
441	    size_t n = (size_t)M * N;
442	    int block = 256, grid = (int)((n + block - 1) / block);
443	    gemm_cast_bias_kernel<T, T><<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(c_fp32, b, out, M, N);
444	    return cudaGetLastError();
445	}

552	// Parallel bias-gradient reduction: db[n] = sum_m dY[m,n]. One block per N
553	// column, block-stride loop over M with a shared-memory tree reduction.
554	// Replaces the single-thread (k==0) db loop that previously serialized the
555	// whole [M] reduction onto one thread per N.
556	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
557	__global__ void grad_bias_reduce_kernel(
558	    const ActT* __restrict__ dY,   // [M, N]
559	    WeightT* __restrict__ db,      // [N]
560	    int M, int N
561	) {
562	    int n = blockIdx.x;
563	    if (n >= N) return;
564	    float acc = 0.0f;
565	    for (int m = threadIdx.x; m < M; m += blockDim.x)
566	        acc += to_f32(dY[(size_t)m * N + n]);
567	    // block reduction (warp shuffle + shared tree)
568	    for (int o = warpSize / 2; o > 0; o >>= 1)
569	        acc += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, acc, o);
570	    __shared__ float red[32];
571	    int lane = threadIdx.x & (warpSize - 1);
572	    int wid  = threadIdx.x / warpSize;
573	    if (lane == 0) red[wid] = acc;
574	    __syncthreads();
575	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
576	        float s = 0.0f;
577	        int nwarp = (blockDim.x + warpSize - 1) / warpSize;
578	        for (int w = 0; w < nwarp; w++) s += red[w];
579	        db[n] = from_f32<WeightT>(s);
580	    }
581	}

583	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
584	inline cudaError_t launch_grad_bias_reduce(
585	    const ActT* dY, WeightT* db, int M, int N, cudaStream_t stream)
586	{
587	    if (db == nullptr) return cudaSuccess;
588	    int block = 256;
589	    grad_bias_reduce_kernel<ActT, WeightT><<<N, block, 0, stream>>>(dY, db, M, N);
590	    return cudaGetLastError();
591	}

593	// dX = dY · W   where Y[m,n] = sum_k W[n,k] X[m,k]; dX[m,k] = sum_n dY[m,n] W[n,k]
594	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
595	__global__ void gemm_grad_input_kernel(
596	    const ActT* __restrict__ dY,     // [M, N]
597	    const WeightT* __restrict__ W,   // [N, K]
598	    ActT* __restrict__ dX,           // [M, K]
599	    int M, int N, int K
600	) {
601	    int m = blockIdx.x;
602	    if (m >= M) return;
603	    for (int k = threadIdx.x; k < K; k += blockDim.x) {
604	        float acc = 0.0f;
605	        for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {
606	            acc += to_f32(dY[(size_t)m * N + n]) * to_f32(W[(size_t)n * K + k]);
607	        }
608	        dX[(size_t)m * K + k] = from_f32<ActT>(acc);
609	    }
610	}

638	// dW[n,k] = sum_m dY[m,n] X[m,k]; db[n] = sum_m dY[m,n]
639	template <typename ActT, typename WeightT>
640	__global__ void gemm_grad_weight_kernel(
641	    const ActT* __restrict__ dY,     // [M, N]
642	    const ActT* __restrict__ X,      // [M, K]
643	    WeightT* __restrict__ dW,        // [N, K]
644	    WeightT* __restrict__ db,        // [N] or nullptr
645	    int M, int N, int K
646	) {
647	    int n = blockIdx.y;
648	    int k = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
649	    if (k >= K) return;
650	    float acc = 0.0f;

874	    extern __shared__ float smem[];   // [blockDim.x]
875	    // 1) sum + sumsq
876	    float s = 0.0f, ss = 0.0f;
877	    for (int d = tid; d < D; d += blockDim.x) {
878	        float v = to_f32(x[(size_t)m * D + d]);
879	        s  += v;
880	        ss += v * v;

883	    smem[tid] = s; __syncthreads();
884	    for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {
885	        if (tid < off) smem[tid] += smem[tid + off];
886	        __syncthreads();
887	    }

889	    __syncthreads();
890	    smem[tid] = ss; __syncthreads();
891	    for (int off = blockDim.x / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {

895	    float total_ss = smem[0];
896	    __syncthreads();

898	    float mu = total_s / (float)D;
899	    float var = total_ss / (float)D - mu * mu;
900	    float inv = fast_rsqrt_nr(var + eps);
901	    if (tid == 0) {
902	        if (mean   != nullptr) mean[m] = mu;
903	        if (invstd != nullptr) invstd[m] = inv;

906	    for (int d = tid; d < D; d += blockDim.x) {
907	        float v = to_f32(x[(size_t)m * D + d]);
908	        float xh = (v - mu) * inv;
909	        float g = (gamma != nullptr) ? to_f32(gamma[d]) : 1.0f;
910	        float bt = (beta != nullptr) ? to_f32(beta[d]) : 0.0f;
